issues.description: Field type mismatch for the primary key 'id' in Person entity: In the template repository Person.java the id field is declared as 'private Long id;' but in the solution repository Person.java the field is declared as 'private Integer id;'. The solution repository's accessor methods (public Long getId(), public void setId(Long id)) use Long as the id type, and PersonRepository in the solution is parametrized as JpaRepository<Person, Long>. This inconsistency (field declared as Integer while getters/setters and repository expect Long) will cause compilation errors and confuses students which type to use for the entity id.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the id type consistent across the entity, its accessors, and the repository. Recommended fix: change the solution repository's Person.id declaration from 'private Integer id;' to 'private Long id;' so it matches the getter/setter signatures and JpaRepository<Person, Long>. Alternatively, if Integer is preferred, update the getters/setters to use Integer and change PersonRepository's generic parameter to JpaRepository<Person, Integer>, but prefer using Long to match the template and repository contract.
